title: Cache stampede on popular product keys
description: Simultaneous expiry of hot catalog keys causes bursts of PostgreSQL queries and latency spikes (CONV-008).

comments.author: Priya Raman
comments.content: Lock uses SET NX with a 2s expiry; waiters retry the cache once before falling back to the database.

resolution: Added +/-10 percent TTL jitter and a per-key refill lock with a 2 second timeout. Runbook DOC-007 updated.
